# Verification-only step before irreversible venmo payment request creation

# Ensure variables exist; if not, recompute from known order/cart results

order_id = 3146
matthew_email = 'matthew.blac@gmail.com'
paid_amount = None

# Fetch paid_amount from amazon order to avoid guessing
amazon_password = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]['password']
amazon_token = apis.amazon.login(username='connorbrow@gmail.com', password=amazon_password)['access_token']
order = apis.amazon.show_order(order_id=order_id, access_token=amazon_token)
paid_amount = order.get('paid_amount')

# Compose payload (same as intended earlier)
payload = {
    'user_email': matthew_email,
    'amount': float(paid_amount),
    'description': f'Amazon order #{order_id} socks (paid {paid_amount:.2f})',
    'private': False,
}

# Check no existing sent payment request to matthew with same amount (paginate fully)
venmo_password = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='connorbrow@gmail.com', password=venmo_password)['access_token']

page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_reqs=[]
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_reqs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

matches=[]
for r in all_reqs:
    recv=(r.get('receiver') or {}).get('email','')
    if isinstance(recv,str) and recv.lower()==matthew_email.lower():
        amt=r.get('amount')
        if amt is not None:
            if abs(float(amt)-float(paid_amount)) < 0.01:
                matches.append(r)

print('Verification table for Venmo request:')
print('receiver_email | amount | order_id | existing_matching_requests')
print(f"{payload['user_email']} | {payload['amount']:.2f} | {order_id} | {len(matches)}")
print('Payload:')
print(payload)
